label: Baur et al. via Quantpedia
claim: A large study of day-of-week, time-of-day and month effects found **"no consistent or persistent patterns"** ([Baur et al. via Quantpedia]).

label: Quantpedia
claim: Quantpedia's overnight-session BTC rule looked good out-of-sample, but it trades about three round trips a week with costs unmodeled ([Quantpedia]).

label: Galaxy via KuCoin
claim: Galaxy's own figures show shrinking amplitude, with peak-to-trough declines of 85%, 84% and 77% ([Galaxy via KuCoin]), so it cannot be validated statistically.

label: The Tie 2026
claim: A study of 1,844 listings from 2023 to 2026 found returns accrue **before Day 0 and mean-revert within one to two weeks**, with the effect shrinking since the 2023 cohort ([The Tie 2026]).

label: UTS
claim: Part of the pre-announcement run-up is consistent with insider leakage in an estimated **10–25% of Coinbase listings** ([UTS]).

label: Xu & Livshits
claim: Insider trading and pump-and-dump participation are illegal, and late pump participants lose in aggregate ([Xu & Livshits]), so neither is a strategy.

label: BeInCrypto on Keyrock
claim: Token unlocks show the most consistent negative drift: about 90% of 16,000+ unlocks produced price pressure, and team unlocks saw average drops of up to 25% ([BeInCrypto on Keyrock]).

label: CSH
claim: Hacks crashed prices in 12 of 22 major DeFi attacks, with an average 14% token loss ([CSH]).

label: NY Fed SR1052
claim: Macro releases barely move BTC, except a CPI effect that vanishes when the sample ends in 2021 ([NY Fed SR1052]).

label: Makarov & Schoar summary
claim: Each needs capital-controlled fiat rails, multiple venues, sub-second latency, AP status or on-chain infrastructure, and none is reachable from a single Coinbase spot account ([Makarov & Schoar summary]; [Albers et al.]; [Fritsch & Canidio]).

label: BIS WP 1087
claim: Crypto futures carry has averaged **above 10% a year and reached 60%** ([BIS WP 1087]).

label: The Block

label: Deribit Insights
